commands.command: cargo clippy -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-machine -p quansio-server --all-targets -- -D warnings
git clone . && arch_check.py && pytest tests/architecture && validate_v81.py  # clean clone

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack> cargo test --no-fail-fast -p quansio-machine -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-server  # 1344 passed, 0 failed. New: qworkerd tests/daemon_concurrency.rs (real binary, real socket, real processes: a long command does not hold the channel and heartbeats continue; --max-concurrent bounds and a waiting dispatch cancelled never runs; a running one is interrupted and does not finish; a re-delivery while running is answered from that run), server worker_host.rs and worker_live.rs (CancelRun through the API stops the run's command on the worker and leaves another run's alone)
cd apps/desktop && tsc --noEmit && eslint src tests
cd apps/desktop && vitest run  # 68 files, 676 passed, 4 skipped (the skips are the suite's own)

mutation checks, 7 of 7 KILLED, every mutant compiles, restored tree identical, control passes: one-at-a-time dispatch; cancel ignored by the worker; no concurrency bound; re-delivery while running runs again; a running dispatch cannot be stopped; CancelRun does not reach the worker; an interrupted call settled as a known failure
